title: Google Launches Pixel Tag, a $30 Item Tracker for Android
excerpt: Google has released the Pixel Tag, a $30 tracking device designed for Android users to help locate lost items.
body_html:
Google has released the Pixel Tag, a new item tracking device priced at $30. Designed for Android users, the tracker functions similarly to Apple's AirTag.

Users can attach the device to personal belongings and use their Android devices to track and locate lost items.
